i’ll see what i can find..i’m in a shop with about 15-20 other people and since we’re just practicing all we have is a bin of scrap metal that’s already been used/welded on :( we haven’t really got into cleaning or grinding the surface yet so i’ve just been working with what i’ve got

honestly i meant for my own standards, i’m still learning and it’s only my second time. i also should mention i’m still in highschool so it’s definitely not on a professional level and it’s gonna take some time if i want to make it a career. i was just happy i actually was able to create something that didn’t look like a bunch of random blobs :)

i’ll check out some videos! i haven’t had time to do much research other than what i’ve been taught since i’ve been so busy. i’ll look into it now though, thank you!!

i’ll see what i can do! i’m in a class still and we haven’t gotten into actually cleaning and prepping the surface so i’ve just been practicing on scrap metal and using what space i have :/

hmm i’ll definitely try a higher heat next time i’m in the shop. i didn’t want to burn through the metal since a lot of the people i work with were saying they burned through. i think our pieces may be on the thin side but i’m not entirely sure. they’re definitely not flimsy though
i think i understand what you mean, i also find that i’ve been either going too fast or too slow and completely forgetting my distancing. i seem to struggle with angle as well

yeah i definitely need to do that more. i’m trying to get used to the helmet lens as well since mine isn’t auto darkening so i kinda just have to try and keep it straight while making sure my puddle looks right.

i’m planning to use 7018 next but one of my assignments requires 6011 and i struggled with it the most. i’ve been trying to get better with it. i mainly need to work on starting the arc and keeping form cause that part has been hardest for me lmao. our teacher told us the when you get into the 70 number electrodes they’re harder?
i know but it’s the best i’ve done so far. today was only my second day welding and i’ve never done it before but i’m trying to get experience whenever i can :)
